name: Mack
descriptor: American welder, early 30s, buzzed dark hair, short dark beard, sun-worn skin, CLEAN well-kept navy work t-shirt, ear protection around his neck, leather work gloves in chest pocket. Strong but real build, never gym-polished. Honest tired-but-good-humored face, direct-to-camera, slight smirk when amused.
voice: Low, gravelly American male voice, unhurried working-man cadence, plain words, dry humor, never announcer-like, never salesy.

anchors.note: The face is clear and well-lit.

notes: FOUNDER RULE: no dirt or grime — credibility comes from the jobsite and gear, never from dirt. Excessive grime is disrespectful to the trade.
